title: Pilobol.us P3-02: guest-read export-published so reader builds hold no credentials (and boto3 in the reader install)
description:
## Goal
Let a static reader build read PUBLISHED content from the CMS with zero credentials: guest (Cognito identity pool, unauthenticated) access, so the reader Amplify app needs no service role, no SSM access and no token. Drafts keep using an editor/JWT lane, only on staging.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06)
- PublishedItem and PublishedMediaAsset are guest-readable (amplify/data/schema.ts: allow.guest().to(["read"])); storage media/* is guest-readable (amplify/storage/resource.ts). preview/* is editor/admin only.
- papyrus content export-published (src/papyrus_content/markus_export_commands.py) calls create_authoring_client(): either the JWT lane (AWS_LAMBDA authorizer; the JWT secret is read from SSM by papyrus auth refresh-jwt and the same token can WRITE) or SigV4 with the default AWS credentials (graphql_use_iam). There is no guest mode.
- The generated reader build spec (infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts readerBuildSpec) installs papyrus-newsroom[markus] and calls papyrus auth refresh-jwt, giving the reader service role ssm:GetParameter on /amplify/<cmsAppId>/*. That is a standing right to mint authoring tokens in every reader build.
- S3MediaStore (src/papyrus_content/media_store.py) needs boto3, which is only in the newsroom extra (heavy: markitdown, tiktoken, tactus). The generated reader and staging specs install [markus] only, so media download would fail with "boto3 is required". This ticket must fix that too.
- Needed public values (not secrets): GraphQL URL, identity pool id, media bucket, region. They are in the backend's amplify_outputs.json.

## Exact changes
1. New src/papyrus_content/guest_auth.py: resolve (endpoint, identity_pool_id, bucket, region) from env PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET, AWS_REGION, falling back to amplify_outputs.json (data.url, auth.identity_pool_id, storage.bucket_name, aws_region). Call cognito-identity GetId then GetCredentialsForIdentity with no credentials (unauthenticated). Provide (a) SigV4 headers for AppSync (service appsync, IAM auth) and (b) a boto3 S3 client built from the guest credentials for S3MediaStore.
2. papyrus content export-published gets --auth guest (also env PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=guest). It refuses --drafts and every other command refuses guest (writes must never run as guest).
3. Make boto3 available to the reader install: add boto3 to the markus extra in pyproject.toml (small), or change the generated reader and staging specs to install [markus,newsroom]. Prefer the first; update docs/standard-site.md 1.3 extras text.
4. Update readerBuildSpec: drop papyrus auth refresh-jwt, use papyrus content export-published --auth guest --out content-export --clean. Keep refresh-jwt in the staging spec (drafts need the editor lane). Reader service role: remove the SSM statement; keep nothing (guest S3 reads use the identity pool role).
5. Tests: unittest with botocore Stubber for GetId/GetCredentialsForIdentity; refusal tests (guest + --drafts, guest + import-markus); behave scenario; a spec snapshot test for the new readerBuildSpec.
6. Live proof on a scratch sandbox (ampx sandbox --identifier <name>; never a production app): import fixture content, publish one item, keep one draft; export-published --auth guest returns the published item and media only; a guest S3 get of preview/ is denied.

## Acceptance checks
- python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<new tests> passes; behave scenario passes; node scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs passes.
- Sandbox proof output pasted here.
- Reader spec has no ssm statement and no refresh-jwt.

## Rollback
Revert the PR (develop only; nothing deployed). Sites on the JWT lane keep working.

## Risks
- The unauthenticated identity role must have appsync:GraphQL on the API and s3:GetObject on media/*: true for the Pretext guest path today; confirm in the sandbox.
- If Ryan chooses the SSM-JWT lane instead (plan decision D2), close this ticket as won't-do and move only item 3 (boto3) into the infra ticket.

## Needs Ryan
Decision D2 in the plan (guest read vs SSM JWT for the reader build). One scratch sandbox AWS SSO login for the proof.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
right_now_summary: The team must choose guest access or SSM tokens before implementation can proceed.
